mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.student_id, s.course_id, st.student_no, st.name AS student_name, st.major, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit, s.usual_score, s.exam_score, s.total_score FROM scores s LEFT JOIN students st ON s.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.course_name

SELECT s.id, s.student_id, s.course_id, st.student_no, st.name AS student_name, st.major, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit, s.usual_score, s.exam_score, s.total_score FROM scores s LEFT JOIN students st ON s.student_id = st.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY st.student_no

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_name AS courseName, c.credit, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2) AS averageScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS passRate, MAX(s.total_score) AS maxScore, MIN(s.total_score) AS minScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 80 AND s.total_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 70 AND s.total_score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mediumCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 60 AND s.total_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM courses c LEFT JOIN scores s ON c.id = s.course_id GROUP BY c.id, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit ORDER BY c.course_no

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.course_no AS courseNo, c.course_name AS courseName, c.credit, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount, ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2) AS averageScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS passRate, MAX(s.total_score) AS maxScore, MIN(s.total_score) AS minScore, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 80 AND s.total_score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 70 AND s.total_score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mediumCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 60 AND s.total_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount FROM courses c LEFT JOIN scores s ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE c.id = #{courseId} GROUP BY c.id, c.course_no, c.course_name, c.credit

SELECT st.major, ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2) AS averageScore, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 90 THEN 4.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 85 THEN 3.7 WHEN s.total_score >= 82 THEN 3.3 WHEN s.total_score >= 78 THEN 3.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 75 THEN 2.7 WHEN s.total_score >= 72 THEN 2.3 WHEN s.total_score >= 68 THEN 2.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 64 THEN 1.5 WHEN s.total_score >= 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END ), 2) AS averageGpa, COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) AS studentCount FROM students st JOIN scores s ON st.id = s.student_id GROUP BY st.major ORDER BY averageGpa DESC

SELECT st.id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, st.major, ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 90 THEN 4.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 85 THEN 3.7 WHEN s.total_score >= 82 THEN 3.3 WHEN s.total_score >= 78 THEN 3.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 75 THEN 2.7 WHEN s.total_score >= 72 THEN 2.3 WHEN s.total_score >= 68 THEN 2.0 WHEN s.total_score >= 64 THEN 1.5 WHEN s.total_score >= 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END ), 2) AS gpa FROM students st JOIN scores s ON st.id = s.student_id GROUP BY st.id, st.student_no, st.name, st.major HAVING COUNT(s.id) > 0 ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ROUND(AVG( CASE WHEN total_score >= 90 THEN 4.0 WHEN total_score >= 85 THEN 3.7 WHEN total_score >= 82 THEN 3.3 WHEN total_score >= 78 THEN 3.0 WHEN total_score >= 75 THEN 2.7 WHEN total_score >= 72 THEN 2.3 WHEN total_score >= 68 THEN 2.0 WHEN total_score >= 64 THEN 1.5 WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END ), 2) FROM scores
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) FROM scores
